products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a non-profit government research lab founded in 2020. Its site describes it as a global scientific research center and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). Its work centers on the Falcon LLM family, which the institute presents as generative large language models intended to make advanced AI widely accessible.

The Falcon line spans several models. Falcon-H1 uses a hybrid architecture based on Transformer and Mamba, and Falcon H1R 7B is described as a 7B reasoning model for mathematics, coding, logic and instruction-following. Falcon Perception is a multimodal model that reads and interprets images from natural language prompts, and Falcon Arabic targets Modern Standard Arabic and dialects. Falcon Mamba 7B is described as the first open source State Space Language Model. Falcon 180B carries 180 billion parameters and was trained on 3.5 trillion tokens; Falcon 40B carries 40 billion parameters and was trained on one trillion tokens; Falcon 10B is the subject of a Call for Proposals run by AI71, a company launched by ATRC and VentureOne. The institute also announced the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit aimed at open-source generative AI models. The site claims Falcon-H1 outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, that Falcon 2 11B outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google's Gemma 7B, and that Falcon Arabic is the region's best-performing Arabic model.

The institute's tracked product is Falcon (TII), listed as a UAE-hosted open-source LLM with Apache 2.0 licensing and Middle East data residency, positioned around sovereign AI. No litigation involving the institute is recorded.
